title: Help with pixel scaling stretching issues

posts.author: Neil_Marie
posts.body:
Today I just upgraded from MV to MZ because it was on sale and I'm encountering an issue. When using the same
Pixel scaling plugin
I would use for MV, I get this really ugly looking pixel stretching.
Yes this DOES technically happen in my MV projects, but I fix it by using Yanfly's core engine (via the update real scale option).
but MZ doesn't have an official version of the Yanfly Engine.
And yes, although dumb, I did try just using the MV version in MZ but the update real scale still causes pixel stretching.
Does anyone who's had this issue in the past have a fix for it? I've been trying for hours and I feel like I'm loosing braincells... issues like this is why I rage quit using MV for a long time and moved to VX Ace because it has Fulscreen++ and 2003 because it has built in window scaling. I really just want to get the most possible out of the engine.
For those wondering, I'm using the engine in its default resolution on a 1080p monitor right now (I'm away from home, my main is a 1440x 2560)
